name_input: ORACLE INDIA PVT LTD; ORACLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for ORACLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED shows 9903 records, but every visible row has India as DESTINATION, e.g. "2026-02-28 | ORACLE CAPAC SERVICES UC | ORACLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | ...CONTACTLESS SMART CARD... | SAN FRANCISCO CA, UNITED STATES | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 85235290 | BOL 7807762" and "2026-02-27 | ORACLE CAPAC SERVICES UC (SINGAPORE BRANCH) | ORACLE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | 8203778 Assy Bracketed 14TB LFF SAS HDD 4U102 | SINGAPORE, THAILAND | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 84717020 | BOL 7791058". No row with India as origin/destination abroad was seen. Source counter: page claims "Total Shipments 9903 Records detected", "Trading Partners 97", "Ports 40", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually rendered in free view = 5 shipment rows (all imports).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India revenue split could be retrieved: web_search backend returned "no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)" on both queries, and volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden while importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge page. No domestic supply record was read, so nothing is asserted.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data as an importer of Oracle hardware (Exadata, HDD assemblies, Arista switches, smart cards) from Oracle Capac Services (US/Singapore/Ireland) into Bangalore ACC, Delhi Air Cargo and Hyderabad ACC — this is inbound logistics for the Indian subsidiary, not export supply. Declared HS 847330 is a parts-of-computers heading; the observed import lines carry 85235290, 84715000, 84717020 and 85176290, so the declared code does not match the actual shipment lines — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, only a code correction note. Export status: no export shipment with India as origin, date, destination and B/L was found in the accessible free views; the 9903-record counter could not be enumerated, so absence is limited to what was visible. Domestic status: unknown, not 'none_found' — the search backend was down and all four trade-data mirrors blocked access, so no GST/tender evidence was read either way. No revenue or export volume figures are public in the sources read; left null rather than estimated. Role: this is the Indian arm of a US software/hardware vendor (importer/distributor of group products), not a manufacturer or independent trader.
